_comment: Manual overrides per species, keyed by scientific name: {"include": [inat photo ids, forced in first, in this order], "exclude": [inat photo ids never chosen], "description": {"summary", "field_marks", "size", "habitat": text written over the Wikipedia-derived fields}, "limit": N cleared candidates to consider instead of the build's --limit, "trust_article": true to take a Wikipedia article whose lead names neither the BirdNET binomial nor the BirdNET common name}. Photo ids are in the pack's report.json and LICENSE.

Melozone crissalis._why: leucistic (white) birds; not how a California Towhee looks

Haemorhous mexicanus._why: birds held in a hand, and a dead bird on pavement

Zenaida macroura._why: macros of feathers in a hand, not a bird

Pyrocephalus rubinus._why: BirdNET calls it Scarlet Flycatcher, Pyrocephalus rubinus; Wikipedia's Vermilion flycatcher article is Pyrocephalus obscurus after the split, and is the right bird for Los Angeles

Haliaeetus leucocephalus._why: most Los Angeles photos are of a distant bird over a reservoir (the first 60 candidates gave two usable crops); the automatic top two were juveniles, all brown, so the adults with the white head go first
